description: Prepare withdrawing from an LP vault the wallet's own shares (those it received by transfer too), every share its free cash pays when shares is omitted. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

maxSlippageBps.description: Most the conversion may move against you, in bps; 50 when omitted

shares.description: Shares to redeem, raw, in the vault's own decimals (its shareDecimals in gage_lp_vaults and the portfolio, 18 or 12: 10^shareDecimals shares were worth 1 USDG when the vault opened); every share the vault's free cash pays when omitted

vault.description: An LP vault: one gage_lp_vaults lists (the manifest's, or one a curator opened through the lane's factory)

name: gage_prepare_lp_redeem
title: Prepare: Withdraw from an LP vault
